evidence.reason: At the current tip, boot() spawns QEMU via subprocess.Popen at line 712, then writes the recorder entry at lines 714-715 outside the try/except cleanup block that begins at line 716. If recorder.append raises, the spawned process is never terminated, process.json has not been written, and the stale file removal at lines 701-705 means cleanup has no identity or pid to stop. That is an ordinary resource-cleanup defect in existing launch behavior; moving the append into the protected region (or otherwise binding cleanup to the spawned process immediately) is the smallest compatible fix.
